$comment: Which BC versions the code pillar snapshots in full. Older versions are kept as diffs only (v0.2+). Base App exists in microsoft/BCApps only from 29.0; 28.x Base App comes from StefanMaron's history repos. `diff_only` majors (23-27, D62) are extracted into the runner's cache: the repository keeps their version diffs and a skeleton (key, name, hash, obsolete state) for the timelines, no countries and no apps. They come from the sandbox history, which has w1-23 to w1-29; only the branch they are read from is listed, so ingest discovers no code items it would decline.

callgraph.$comment: D67 call graph (pipeline/code/callgraph.ts, code pillar `linked`): `apps` true = graphify-al runs on the W1 app folders plus the first-party apps (`code.<source>.apps`, src/Apps/W1/*/app), false = W1 only. Decided by the spike (docs/specs/code-atlas.md section 7: W1 + apps must finish under 30 minutes and 6 GB RSS). Changing it puts every snapshot major back at `linked` on the next ingest.

code.$comment: What the code job extracts per snapshot source (PLAN 4.6, D27). W1 apps in full; countries as overlays (objects new or changed against W1). BCApps carries every layer in one checkout and stacks them (layers_config.json: AT on DACH on W1, each layer may exclude inherited files); regional layers (APAC, DACH, NA) are bases, not countries. `apps` = Microsoft's first-party apps (Shopify, Power BI Reports, ...), their own snapshot data/code/<major>/apps (no tests, no demo data), kept out of W1 so version diffs compare like with like. Code History has one complete branch per country, so its list is explicit. `country_apps` = a country's own extension apps (src/Apps/<layer>/*/app), expanded for every layer of its chain after W1, so US gets NA's apps and its own, like its base-app view; DK and IN ship their whole localization this way (D58). `country_apps_exclude` drops the demo-data apps from a country view: Contoso sample data is not localization, and it would inflate every narrative and the heatmap.

sandbox-history.$comment: `path` lists candidate folders, most specific first; the first that exists wins (job.ts resolveApps). BC25+ keep the apps at the top level; w1-23 and w1-24 have BaseApp/Source/Base Application, BusinessFoundation/Source/Business Foundation and System Application/Source (lower case on w1-23), each next to a Test folder that must not be extracted.
